notes.title: Pre-release
notes.notes:
The inspiration for this game comes from old 16-bit games, so be prepared for challenging battles and puzzles!

If you enjoy difficult challenges, survivor horror, and an intricate and immersive story, we bet that you are going to like it. Come with us and try to survive and solve the mystery behind Project: Prequel.
